build_dir: a1/a2 on work/agent-battle-build-9 (pre-fix), a3 on work/agent-battle-build-10; Mega Altaria evolved on its first action on both builds, so no Mega-related replay is required

attempts.notes: Psychic Terrain blocked Fake Out and Sucker Punch; Indeedee Follow Me + Gallade Sharpness Sacred Sword OHKO'd Mega Kangaskhan on T2; Make It Rain + Draco Meteor removed Indeedee/Gallade, Iron Head/Knock Off removed Gardevoir/Lele, then Assault Vest Magearna (+3 Soul-Heart) walled the -4 SpA Gholdengo and Fleur Cannon/Aura Sphere took the rest; my Thunderclap into Mega Altaria was a misread (Dragon resists Electric).

Same Kangaskhan-for-Indeedee trade; Overheat KO'd Gallade and Thunderbolt/Moonblast trades removed Gardevoir, but two Moonblasts KO'd Kingambit, Aura Sphere OHKO'd Incineroar from full (394) and Magearna at +3 then Mega Altaria finished a 1-HP Whimsicott.

T1 Protect + Tailwind; T2-T3 two spread Heat Waves through Follow Me KO'd Gallade and (with Double-Edge) Indeedee while Whimsicott's Sash absorbed Psycho Cut; the AI switched Gardevoir out for Magearna into a 2x Heat Wave, which then KO'd Magearna T5 as Double-Edge OHKO'd Gardevoir; Lele Protected one Double-Edge and died to the next; Kingambit Iron Head (2x) KO'd Mega Altaria as it KO'd Kangaskhan with Pixilate Return.

strategy_checks.check: Indeedee Psychic Terrain on entry + Follow Me protecting Gallade
strategy_checks.evidence: Terrain at turn 0 every attempt; Follow Me T1-T4 in all attempts redirected every single-target attack; only spread Heat Wave/Make It Rain reached Gallade. Terrain blocked my Fake Out and Sucker Punch (a1 T2, a3 T6).

strategy_checks.check: Gallade Sharpness Sacred Sword / Psycho Cut
strategy_checks.evidence: Sacred Sword OHKO'd Mega Kangaskhan a1/a2 T2 (352); Psycho Cut on Whimsicott a3 T1-T2 (KO reads); Protect a2 T3 blocked a Heat Wave + Draco KO.

strategy_checks.check: Gardevoir Trace copies the most valuable ability
strategy_checks.evidence: Traced Good as Gold (a1) and Beads of Ruin (a2, a3) on entry.

strategy_checks.check: Tapu Lele Psychic Surge re-establishes terrain, boosted Psychic/Psyshock
strategy_checks.evidence: a3 T5 terrain reset to 5 turns on entry; Psychic chosen into Kangaskhan (a3 T7, would have KO'd); Protect a2 T6 / a3 T6 blocked KOs.

+1 per faint observed to +3 (a1); Fleur Cannon OHKO ranges on Raging Bolt forced two Protects; Aura Sphere OHKO'd Incineroar (a2 T7) and Kingambit's 4x weakness was correctly targeted with Mystical Fire on Gardevoir instead.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Altaria Pixilate Return + Dragon Dance closer
strategy_checks.evidence: Mega Evolved on first action all three attempts; Dragon Dance a1 T8 then +1 Return KO'd Whimsicott/Bolt; a3 Return chosen every turn (KO reads) and KO'd Kangaskhan on the last turn.

ai_defects.description: a3 T4: the AI hard-switched Gardevoir out for Magearna while Chi-Yu's spread Heat Wave was selected; Magearna (Steel/Fairy) took it 2x on entry and died to the next Heat Wave before acting. Same switch-into-super-effective family as 327/328.

calibration: Lost twice (4-6, 4-6), won 6-2 on the third attempt after changing leads; two faints in the win. A real post-League fight - keep offsets 1/2/2/2/2/3.
cooler: The rival arc lands: Follow Me + Sharpness Gallade is a genuinely hard opening and the Altaria payoff is memorable. Cooler still if the AI did not switch Magearna into a spread Fire attack; Gallade's Night Slash was never chosen even into Gholdengo (2x), where it was the KO.
legality: No legality problem found in the authored set.
